blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Motorists traveling along EDSA southbound will encounter temporary lane closures from Friday night, Oct. 30. This situation will happen as the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) goes on the second phase of the highway’s rehabilitation. The repair works will cover three sections – near the NEPA Q-Mart Bus Station, past the EDSA Kamuning Flyover and Shaw Underpass, through Boni Avenue, and toward Guadalupe.
